question: PV Sindhu won the bronze medal in the Badminton Women's singles category at the Olympics held in Tokyo in 2021 by beating ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __He Bing Jiao.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian star shuttler PV Sindhu has secured a bronze medal at the Tokyo Olympics, defeating China’s He Bing Jiao in Women’s Singles.
 
• PV Sindhu also created history by becoming the first Indian woman to win two consecutive individual Olympic medals.
 
• She had won silver at Rio Olympics in 2016.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
